title.en: Accountant-General Appointed to be Accountant for Supreme Court

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Supreme Court of Judicature Act
(CHAPTER 322, Section 66)
Accountant-General Appointed to be Accountant for Supreme Court
N 2
REVISED EDITION 1997
(26th September 1997)
[18th February 1970]
The Chief Justice has appointed the Accountant-General to be the Accountant for the Supreme Court.
